children: Braze (

, the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™, today announced that it has been named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026. Braze received the highest score in the Strategy category and the highest possible scores in nine criteria.

As brands bring AI into customer engagement, marketers need to understand where it improves the customer experience and how it contributes to business results. Braze connects real-time customer data with cross-channel orchestration and AI-powered decisioning, helping teams act on individual customer needs while reducing the manual work involved in building and optimizing campaigns.

In its evaluation, Forrester wrote that Braze’s “AI innovation, pragmatic roadmap, and active user community position Braze for enterprise expansion beyond its global digital-first base.” The report also cited customer praise for the platform’s usability and innovation, alongside its responsive partnership approach in supporting complex deployments. Additionally, the report recognizes Braze as a vendor with above-average customer feedback.

“Marketers have no shortage of ideas for building better relationships with their customers. The challenge is giving them the time and tools to put those ideas to work, and a clear way to understand the value they create,” said Astha Malik, Chief Business Officer, Braze. “We believe this recognition reflects the progress we have made in bringing AI into the work marketers do every day. Our focus is helping them make more relevant decisions for each customer and build on what works as those relationships evolve.”

Braze enables brands to orchestrate customer journeys across email, mobile, web, and other messaging channels, using customer behavior to adapt engagement in real time. BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™ applies reinforcement learning to continuously test and optimize individual experiences against business objectives. BrazeAI Operator™ helps marketers create campaigns and troubleshoot their work, while BrazeAI Agent Console™ enables teams to build and manage AI agents within customer journeys.

Braze believes that making these capabilities accessible within marketers’ existing workflows helps teams move from AI experimentation to practical applications that improve customer engagement. Brands including e.l.f. Cosmetics use Braze to engage their customers.

The focus on business value is also reflected in a separate study commissioned by Braze. In The Total Economic Impact™ Of Braze, an April 2026 study, Forrester Consulting modeled a 457% return on investment over three years and a payback period of less than six months for a composite organization using the Braze platform and BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™. The study drew on interviews with six customers discussing the results they saw from adopting Braze to construct the composite organization.

To learn more about the evaluation and Braze’s placement, access The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026 at: https://www.braze.com/resources/reports-and-guides/forrester-wave-ccmh-2026. The Total Economic Impact™ Of Braze is available at https://www.braze.com/resources/reports-and-guides/the-total-economic-impact-of-braze.
Additional Industry Recognition

Braze was recently named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Multichannel Marketing Hubs and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Marketing Platforms. In the Multichannel Marketing Hubs report, Braze was also positioned highest in Ability to Execute and furthest in Completeness of Vision among the assessed vendors.

About Braze

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to AI-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences. The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. Braze was also named one of Built In’s 2026 Best Places to Work, one of America’s Greenest Companies for 2025 by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®. The company is headquartered in New York with 15 offices across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Learn more at braze.com.
